svg.title: Here are the finite objects to which the integration estimates apply. Fix a coarse-to-fine step, its fine tree F, a seed inventory, a coarse configuration V , local discrete choices k, and the off-tree group variables Y . The active off-tree links are determined by the tree and seed inventory. For a color array u, the fine configuration has link exp(ue)(replica V )e on an active link, the value supplied by Y on an inactive off-tree link, and the fixed tree value on a tree link. The logarithmic signal equals u on active links, zero on tree links, and the chosen cutofflogarithm of Ue(replica V )−1 on inactive e off-tree links. Thus the group configuration and the logarithmic signal are different objects. Their identification by exponentiation is asserted only on the interior domain where the cutofflogarithm agrees with the genuine chart inverse.
